blinding: This packet deliberately excludes: any V2 arm PnL/return table, any per-ETF performance ranking, any winning-period diagnostics, any scored ranking. It contains only mechanism-level lessons, contracts and constraints.

market_and_data.asset_class: US_ETF_CASH (long/cash only; no short leg without separate PIT borrow authority)
available_fields: daily raw OHLCV per ETF (provider daily bar, regular session)
issuer total-return reconstruction inputs (raw + distributions + splits)
forbidden_fields: fundamentals (AUM, expense ratio beyond static knowledge, holdings)
market_and_data.provider_terms: existing Twelve Data Basic USD 0 account only; no new accounts, no paid data, no network fetch during the cycle; raw payloads never committed

S1.status: SEALED_UNTOUCHED - never read for proposal choice, tuning, scoring or diagnostics

windows_and_folds.pit_clock: features use completed sessions only; a signal computed from data through session T is executable at the NEXT session's event; no same-session look-ahead

constraints.books: deterministic long/cash target weights; explicit CASH leg allowed and handled canonically (CASH never counted in tradable-leg turnover)
constraints.base_costs: 10 bps per side (2 spread + 3 slippage + 2 ops buffer + 3 execution allowance) on ETF turnover
constraints.turnover_feasibility_ceiling: 6.0x two-way per year, measured schedule-only before scoring
constraints.capacity: daily ETF cohort, no capacity claim beyond schedule feasibility; no leverage; gross exposure <= 1.0
constraints.corporate_actions: distributions reinvest via issuer-TR path for accounting; fills at raw prices; splits via official factors

benchmarks_frozen_before_scoring: flat (0.0 return) as the hard benchmark
equal-weight sector ETF total return (10 sector ETFs, SPY excluded)
risk-matched SPY context scaled EX ANTE by the arm's frozen gross/vol rule
benchmark_and_alpha_contract.incremental_mechanism_alpha: defined separately from raw PnL: after-cost strategy return minus the risk-matched SPY benchmark return per fold; a family cannot pass merely because long equity beta rose; anchor must show positive risk-matched excess in >=2/3 folds and positive incremental mechanism alpha
benchmark_and_alpha_contract.beta_falsification: every family must include a causal negative control able to separate the mechanism from market/sector beta; a control that reproduces the anchor falsifies the mechanism

stage_a_gates_preregistered: per-arm largest positive-fold share <= 50% (per-arm positive fold contribution / same arm's total positive fold contribution)
no single ETF contributes > 35% of positive PnL/risk
sufficient decisions/positions for the family's frozen clock across all folds
stress PnL > 0 and stress PF >= 1.00 at 2x costs
realised turnover and capacity inside the frozen schedule gate
anchor risk-matched excess over SPY positive in >= 2/3 folds
neighbour supports the anchor mechanism direction
control shows opposite incremental-alpha sign OR absolute control alpha < 50% of absolute anchor alpha

budget.historical_denominator: 6 prior Stocks observations; statistical claims need >=6 historical plus all computed V3 results or stay UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED
budget.note: stress/drop-one diagnostics belong to their frozen base arm and create no extra trials

prior_mechanism_lessons: in this 11-ETF cohort/window, market and sector beta explained nearly all of a top-ranked momentum anchor's return: the preregistered bottom-ranked control reproduced the anchor's expectancy almost exactly, falsifying the ranking mechanism

a trend/defensive rotation failed drawdown and drop-one robustness gates; its 'concentration unavailable' evidence was later proven a bookkeeping artifact, which changed the label but not the rejection
raw percentage PnL is not evidence: both prior families earned positive PnL while carrying no incremental edge over beta
fold-positive-share numbers must come from ONE consistent per-arm definition or they are unreproducible
sidecar accounting must equal canonical harness valuation; CASH is not a tradable leg; costs are charged exactly once
issuer distributions and provider adjust=all conflicted on five 2025-12-05 2:1 splits; issuer-TR reconstruction is the accounting authority

mechanism_families_closed: cross-sectional relative momentum over sector ETFs (any lookback, any top-K, any subset)
time-series trend / SMA / EMA / vol-targeted defensive rotation (any variant)
rescue of any selected-ETF subset chosen after observing outcomes
any strategy whose expected profit is simply long SPY/sector beta
earnings, fundamentals, borrow, institutional-flow or quote-spread mechanisms without current PIT data
daily-indicator grids without a distinct economic mechanism
anything requiring new accounts, paid data or network fetch
forbidden_ancestry.note: the full family inventory with reasons is in research/control/stocks_free_v3_run/forbidden_family_inventory.json ( Stocks and prior crypto ancestry for novelty only)

proposal_requirements: primary-source claim (citable academic/issuer/exchange documentation) and the ETF-market mechanism
expected counterparty and a falsifiable expected sign
required fields and their PIT availability
universe, formation, holding, decision and execution clocks
long/cash target construction and cash semantics
turnover, capacity, cost and distribution/split handling
expected behaviour against all four benchmarks
anchor + theoretically justified neighbour + causal negative control (distinct identities)
incremental mechanism test that distinguishes alpha from equity beta
exact falsification rule and implementation estimate
ancestry comparison showing it is not a rescue of a closed family
priority_search_spaces_not_mandatory: idiosyncratic sector-shock reversal with market return removed before ranking
volatility-event recovery with predeclared event and holding clocks
hard_rule: proposal agents compute NO returns, PnL, profit factor, Sharpe, rankings or correlations on the scored S0 window; proposals are documents only
